headline: Five endangered secretarybird chicks hatch at Chester Zoo
summary: The chicks are the first secretarybirds bred at the zoo in its 95-year history, a landmark step for one of Africa's rarest birds of prey.
script: Five endangered secretarybird chicks have hatched at Chester Zoo. It is the first time the African birds of prey have bred at the zoo in its ninety-five year history, and conservationists are calling it a major breakthrough.
imageAlt: A keeper feeds a tiny secretarybird chick with tweezers at Chester Zoo.
imageAltTwo: A close-up of a secretarybird chick with its beak open.
